column1: # Perl corpus: io. Format and regeneration: crates/builtins/src/perl/tests.rs.

column2: chdir "parts" or die $!; open my $f,"<","a" or die $!; print scalar <$f>;
local $/="b"; open my $f,"<","data" or die $!; print join("|",map {unpack "H*",$_} <$f>),"\n";
opendir my $d,"parts" or die $!; my $at=telldir($d); my $first=readdir($d); seekdir($d,$at); print readdir($d) eq $first ? 1:0,"\n";
opendir my $d,"parts" or die $!; print join("|",sort readdir($d)),"\n"; closedir $d;
opendir my $d,"parts" or die $!; my @a=readdir $d; rewinddir $d; my @b=readdir $d; print join(",",sort @a) eq join(",",sort @b)?1:0,"\n";
open my $f,"<","data" or die $!; print eof($f)?1:0,"|"; my @all=<$f>; print eof($f)?1:0,"\n";
chmod 0600,"data" or die $!; print join("|",map {$_?1:0} -r "data",-w "data",-x "data"),"\n";
print -s "data","|",-z "empty"?1:0,"\n";
print -f -s "data" ? 1:0,"\n";
print -T "data"?1:0,"|",-B "binary"?1:0,"\n";
print join("|",map {$_?1:0} -f "data",-d "parts",-e "missing",-d "data",-e "data"),"\n";
local $/=\3; open my $f,"<","data" or die $!; print join("|",map {unpack "H*",$_} <$f>),"\n";
open DATAFILE,"<","data" or die $!; print scalar <DATAFILE>; close DATAFILE;
my $s="old"; open my $f,">>",\$s or die $!; print {$f} "new"; close $f; print "$s\n";
my $s="aa\nbb\n"; open my $f,"<",\$s or die $!; print scalar <$f>;
my $s="abcd"; open my $f,"<",\$s or die $!; seek $f,2,0; print getc($f),"|",tell($f),"\n";
my $s="old"; open my $f,">",\$s or die $!; print {$f} "new"; close $f; print "$s\n";
mkdir "new" or die $!; print -d "new"?1:0,"|"; rmdir "new" or die $!; print -d "new"?1:0,"\n";
open my $f,"+>>","data" or die $!; seek $f,0,0 or die $!; print {$f} "xyz"; close $f;
open my $f,">>","data" or die $!; print {$f} "xyz"; close $f or die $!;
print open(my $f,"<","not-there") ? "opened\n" : "missing\n";
open my $f,"<"," sub file " or die $!; print scalar <$f>;
open my $f,"data" or die $!; print scalar <$f>;
open my $f,"+<","data" or die $!; seek $f,1,0 or die $!; print {$f} "xy"; close $f;
open my $f,"<","data" or die $!; print scalar <$f>;
open my $f,"+>","data" or die $!; print {$f} "xyz"; seek $f,0,0 or die $!; print scalar <$f>;
open my $f,"<data" or die $!; print scalar <$f>;
open my $f,">","data" or die $!; print {$f} "xyz"; close $f or die $!;
local $/=""; open my $f,"<","data" or die $!; print join("|",map {unpack "H*",$_} <$f>),"\n";
open my $f,"<","data" or die $!; my $buf="xyz123"; my $n=read $f,$buf,2,3; print "$n|$buf\n";
open my $f,"<","data" or die $!; my $n=read $f,my $buf,2; print "$n|$buf\n";
open my $f,"<","data" or die $!; print scalar readline($f);
open my $f,"<","data" or die $!; my @a=<$f>; print scalar(@a),"|",join(",",map {chomp;$_} @a),"\n";
rename "data","moved" or die $!; print -e "data"?1:0,"|",-e "moved"?1:0,"\n";
open my $f,"<","data" or die $!; seek $f,-3,2; print tell($f),"|",getc($f),"\n";
open my $f,"<","data" or die $!; seek $f,2,0; seek $f,1,1; print tell($f),"|",getc($f),"\n";
open my $f,">","data" or die $!; my $old=select($f); print "selected"; select($old); close $f; print "normal\n";
local $/; open my $f,"<","data" or die $!; print unpack("H*",scalar <$f>),"\n";
open my $f,"<","data" or die $!; my @st=stat($f); print $st[7],"\n";
my @st=stat("missing"); print scalar(@st),"\n";
my @st=stat("data"); print scalar(@st),"|",$st[7],"\n";
open my $f,"<","data" or die $!; my $n=sysread $f,my $buf,2; print "$n|$buf\n";
open my $f,"<","data" or die $!; my $s=<$f>; print tell($f),"\n";
truncate "data",2 or die $!;
print unlink("data","missing"),"|",-e "data"?1:0,"\n";
